description: Sources of the name dictionary (pilot: Polish and English). Each entry records where the data comes from, its licence as checked at the source, and the checksum the build verifies. Nothing from these files is stored in git.

sources.description: Wikidata given names with a label in pl
sources.query: SELECT DISTINCT ?l WHERE { VALUES ?c { wd:Q202444 wd:Q12308941 wd:Q11879590 wd:Q3409032 } ?i wdt:P31 ?c ; rdfs:label ?l . FILTER(LANG(?l) = "pl") }
sources.note: query results change over time and are not checksummed; the build records the row count
